outlooks.summary: STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED SUNDAY AFTERNOON AND EVENING FROM PARTS OF WESTERN THROUGH NORTH-CENTRAL OKLAHOMA AND EAST-CENTRAL AND NORTHEAST KANSAS INTO THE MIDDLE MISSOURI VALLEY. PRIMARY THREATS WILL BE LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND...BUT A COUPLE OF TORNADOES ARE ALSO POSSIBLE.

sections.title: THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER SOUTH TX
sections.text: ...SUMMARY... STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED SUNDAY AFTERNOON AND EVENING FROM PARTS OF WESTERN THROUGH NORTH-CENTRAL OKLAHOMA AND EAST-CENTRAL AND NORTHEAST KANSAS INTO THE MIDDLE MISSOURI VALLEY. PRIMARY THREATS WILL BE LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND...BUT A COUPLE OF TORNADOES ARE ALSO POSSIBLE.

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: PRIMARY FEATURE OF INTEREST THIS PERIOD WILL BE A CLOSED UPPER LOW THAT WILL ADVANCE EWD THROUGH THE CNTRL/NRN PLAINS TODAY...REACHING THE UPPER MS VALLEY TONIGHT. ATTENDANT SFC LOW WILL DEVELOP THROUGH SD ALONG QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT WITH TRAILING COLD FRONT MOVING SEWD THROUGH THE CNTRL PLAINS. DRYLINE WILL SET UP FROM WRN TX AND EXTEND NWD THROUGH WRN OK INTO SWRN KS WHERE IT WILL INTERSECT THE COLD FRONT.

sections.title: NERN KS THROUGH ERN NEB AND WRN IA
sections.text: NARROW ZONE OF MODIFIED CP AIR WITH MID 50S F DEWPOINTS WILL ADVECT NWD THROUGH PRE-FRONTAL WARM SECTOR BENEATH STEEPENING LAPSE RATES CONTRIBUTING TO AN AXIS OF 1500-2000 J/KG MLCAPE BY MID-LATE AFTERNOON. IN WAKE OF EARLY DAY MID-LEVEL CONVECTION ACCOMPANYING A MINOR LEAD IMPULSE...SOME DIABATIC WARMING OF THE BOUNDARY LAYER SHOULD OCCUR. THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO REDEVELOP DURING THE AFTERNOON ALONG AND AHEAD OF THE FRONT AS A SIGNIFICANT VORTICITY MAXIMUM ROTATES THROUGH THE UPPER TROUGH BASE AND INTO THE CNTRL PLAINS. UNIDIRECTIONAL WIND PROFILES WITH 40-45 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR SHOULD SUPPORT SUPERCELL STORMS WITH SOME LEFT SPLITS CAPABLE OF VERY LARGE HAIL. HAVE INCLUDED AN ENHANCED WHERE STORM COVERAGE SHOULD BE GREATER WITHIN AN ENVIRONMENT SUPPORTIVE OF LARGE HAIL. ACTIVITY WILL SHIFT EWD INTO THE UPPER MS VALLEY BEFORE THE THREAT DIMINISHES TOWARD MID-EVENING AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER STABILIZES.

sections.title: WRN OK THROUGH SCNTRL KS
sections.text: MORE ISOLATED STORMS ARE EXPECTED ALONG SWRN EXTENSION OF THE COLD FRONT IN SOUTH CNTRL KS AND FARTHER SOUTH ALONG DRYLINE IN WRN OK. VERTICAL WIND PROFILES WITH 40-45 KT EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR WILL SUPPORT SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING VERY LARGE HAIL. WHILE LIMITED LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE AND LARGE NEAR-SFC SPREADS WILL LIMIT TORNADO THREAT...A SMALL WINDOW FOR A TORNADO OR TWO WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE DURING THE EARLY EVENING.

sections.title: S TX
sections.text: SRN-STREAM IMPULSE WILL MOVE ACROSS SOUTH TX AND CONTRIBUTE TO SCATTERED TSTM DEVELOPMENT THIS MORNING. ADDITIONAL ISOLATED TO SCATTERED TSTM DEVELOPMENT MAY OCCUR THIS AFTERNOON IN THE WAKE OF THE UPPER IMPULSE...COINCIDENT WITH A GRADUAL STRENGTHENING OF MIDLEVEL FLOW WITHIN A CORRIDOR OF RELATIVELY STRONGER HEATING/DESTABILIZATION. A MARGINAL SVR THREAT...INCLUDING THE POTENTIAL FOR HAIL...MAY ACCOMPANY THESE STORMS. ..DIAL/GLEASON.. 04/24/2016

outlooks.summary: SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS SHOULD FORM THIS AFTERNOON OVER PARTS OF THE LOWER/MIDDLE MISSOURI VALLEY REGION SOUTHWARD TO SOUTH-CENTRAL KANSAS...OFFERING LARGE...DAMAGING HAIL AND OCCASIONAL SEVERE GUSTS. FEWER STORMS ARE EXPECTED INTO WESTERN OKLAHOMA...THOUGH ANY THAT DEVELOP STILL CAN BE SEVERE. A TORNADO OR TWO ALSO IS POSSIBLE EARLY THIS EVENING IN THE OUTLOOK AREA. A SEVERE STORM OR TWO ALSO MAY OCCUR OVER PARTS OF THE LOWER/MIDDLE TEXAS COASTAL PLAIN. --- TECHNICAL DISCUSSION ---

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: MAIN UPPER-AIR FEATURE OF RELEVANCE FOR THIS FCST IS CYCLONE NOW EVIDENT IN MOISTURE-CHANNEL IMAGERY OVER WY...WITH SHORTWAVE TROUGH SWD ACROSS CENTRAL CO AND E-CENTRAL NM. AS STG HEIGHT FALLS OCCUR UPSTREAM OVER WRN CONUS...IN ADVANCE OF AMPLIFYING PAC TROUGH...WY CYCLONE WILL MOVE GENERALLY EWD OVER NEB/SD BORDER. BY 12Z...THIS FEATURE SHOULD OPEN UP TO FORM STG...ZONALLY ORIENTED...OPEN-WAVE TROUGH WITH EMBEDDED 500-MB VORTICITY MAX OVER EXTREME NWRN IA/SWRN MN VICINITY. SECONDARY/SRN-STREAM PERTURBATION -- NOW APPARENT OVER S TX JUST E OF RIO GRANDE -- IS FCST TO MOVE EWD TO SE TX AND NWRN GULF BY 00Z...THEN WEAKEN/DEVOLVE INTO DISORGANIZED VORTICITY PATTERN OVER NRN GULF AND LA THEREAFTER. AT SFC...DEEP LOW ANALYZED AT 11Z OVER W-CENTRAL SD IS EXPECTED TO OCCLUDE AND REMAIN QUASISTATIONARY THROUGH EARLY AFTN BEFORE MOVING SLOWLY EWD ACROSS CENTRAL SD...REACHING PIR/HON/MHE AREA AROUND 00Z. LOW THEN WILL FILL AND ACCELERATE EWD...BECOMING VERTICALLY STACKED WITH 500-MB VORTICITY MAX OVER SWRN MN AREA NEAR END OF PERIOD. DRYLINE WAS ANALYZED AT 11Z FROM N-CENTRAL NEB SSWWD ACROSS WRN KS...NWRN TX PANHANDLE...SERN NM AND TX BIG BEND REGION. DRYLINE SHOULD SHIFT EWD BY 00Z TO NEAR

sections.title: MID/LOWER MO VALLEY TO WRN OK
sections.text: SCATTERED TSTMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP THIS AFTN IN ZONES OF RELATIVELY MAXIMIZED CONVERGENCE ALONG/AHEAD OF DRYLINE...FROM PORTIONS ERN NEB SSWWD TO S-CENTRAL KS. MAIN CONCERNS SHOULD BE LARGE HAIL AND SPORADIC DAMAGING GUSTS. NARROW CORRIDOR OF SFC DEW POINTS LOWER-MID 50S N...AND LOWER-MID 60S S...SHOULD DEVELOP BY LATE AFTN IN SUPPORT OF MLCAPE 800-1500 J/KG. BENEATH THAT CAPE...WELL-MIXED THERMODYNAMIC PROFILES WILL CHARACTERIZE BOUNDARY LAYER IN SUPPORT OF STG/SVR GUSTS AND LARGE HAIL REACHING GROUND. GREATEST JUXTAPOSITION OF RELATIVELY DENSE CONVECTIVE COVERAGE WITH FAVORABLE PARAMETER SPACE OF CAPE AND SHEAR SHOULD BE OVER ENH-RISK AREA...WITH MOISTURE AND INSTABILITY DIMINISHING NWD...AND TSTM DENSITY DIMINISHING SWD INTO STRONGER CAPPING. STILL...CONDITIONAL POTENTIAL EXISTS FOR A SUPERCELL OR TWO WITH LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING GUSTS INTO SRN KS AND WRN OK. IN LATTER AREAS...BOUNDARY-LAYER MOISTURE WILL INCREASE AROUND DUSK WITH CONTINUED WAA AND MOISTURE TRANSPORT. THIS WILL KEEP EFFECTIVE-INFLOW PARCELS SFC-BASED FOR A COUPLE HOURS INTO EVENING WHILE LCL LOWERS AND HODOGRAPHS ENLARGE DUE TO 40-45-KT LLJ. TORNADO RISK IS SLGT AT MOST AND ASSOCIATED MAINLY WITH ANY SUSTAI

sections.title: S TX
sections.text: ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED TSTMS SHOULD DEVELOP THIS AFTN IN ZONE OF WEAK CINH AND STG SFC HEATING OF RICHLY MOIST AIR MASS...WITH ISOLATED SVR HAIL/GUSTS POSSIBLE. SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL MOVE AWAY FROM AREA...WITH ASSOCIATED FIELD OF WEAK LARGE-SCALE SUBSIDENCE LIKEWISE DEPARTING BY EARLY-MID AFTN. IR IMAGERY ALREADY INDICATES POCKETS OF CLEARING IN MULTILAYERED CLOUD FIELD BEHIND ONGOING CONVECTION OVER GULF AND MOVING OFFSHORE DEEP S TX. THESE FACTORS...AND LIKELY PRESENCE OF DIFFERENTIAL- HEATING/OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES OVER AREA...WILL CONTRIBUTE TO AFTN CONVECTIVE POTENTIAL. WNWLY-NWLY MIDLEVEL FLOW BEHIND MID/UPPER- LEVEL TROUGH WILL CONTRIBUTE TO STG DIRECTIONAL SHEAR...WHILE SOME LATE-AFTN ENLARGEMENT OF HODOGRAPHS IS POSSIBLE IN SUPPORT OF BOTH ORGANIZED MULTICELLS AND ISOLATED SUPERCELL THREAT. COVERAGE OF SVR MAY BE MORE DENSE THAN MRGL OUTLOOK CRITERIA ON SCALE OF A FEW COUNTIES...HOWEVER MESOSCALE UNCERTAINTIES PRECLUDE LARGER UNCONDITIONAL PROBABILITIES ATTM. ..EDWARDS/COOK.. 04/24/2016

sections.text: NARROW CORRIDOR OF SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE UPR 50S TO AROUND 60 F SHOULD BECOME ESTABLISHED BY MID AFTN AHEAD OF SHARPENING DRY LINE/LEE TROUGH FROM ERN NEB WRN IA SSW INTO E CNTRL KS AND WRN/CNTRL OK AS 35-40 KT SSW LOW-LVL FLOW CONTINUES ACROSS REGION. GIVEN FAIRLY DEEP...WELL-MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER...COOL MID-LVL TEMPERATURES /AOB MINUS 14C AT 500 MB/...AND 50+ SW TO SSW MID-LVL FLOW...SETUP WILL YIELD SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF BOTH VERY LARGE HAIL AND DMGG WIND...IN ADDITION TO A TORNADO OR TWO. MULTICELL STORMS/STORM CLUSTERS WITH A RISK FOR MAINLY HAIL SHOULD DEVELOP NWD INTO ERN SD/WRN MN. WHILE CONVECTION MAY BE MOST CONCENTRATED IN NEB...THE POTENTIAL FOR DISCRETE OR LONGER-LIVED DISCRETE ACTIVITY SHOULD BE GREATER FARTHER S ACROSS KS AND NRN OK. AND...ALTHOUGH ENHANCED SVR THREAT SHOULD BE GREATEST LATE THIS AFTN AND EVE FROM PARTS OF CNTRL AND ERN KS NNE INTO ERN NEB...CONTINUED INFLOW OF LOW-LVL MOISTURE...NOCTURNAL STRENGTHENING OF LLJ...AND MORE DISCRETE STORM MODE MAY A

sections.text: ISOLD TO WDLY SCTD TSTMS EXPECTED THIS AFTN OVER THE SRN AND PERHAPS MIDDLE TX GULF CSTL PLN AS POCKETS OF ENHANCED SFC HEATING DEVELOP IN MOIST /PW AOA 1.50 INCHES/...WEAKLY-CAPPED ENVIRONMENT IN WAKE OF DEPARTING UPR IMPULSE. ALTHOUGH MODEST LARGE-SCALE SUBSIDENCE/MID-LVL WARMING SHOULD LIMIT STORM COVERAGE...DEVELOPING NWLY MID-LVL FLOW BEHIND UPR SYSTEM WILL YIELD LENGTHENING HODOGRAPHS...AND AMPLE /40+ KT/ DIRECTIONAL SHEAR TO SUPPORT SUSTAINED STORMS/POSSIBLE SUPERCELLS. THIS ACTIVITY COULD EVOLVE INTO A SMALL SWD-MOVING MCS...WITH EMBEDDED CELLS POSSIBLY POSING A RISK FOR LARGE HAIL...LOCALLY DMGG WIND...AND A NON-ZERO RISK FOR A TORNADO. ..CORFIDI/ROGERS.. 04/24/2016

sections.text: SOME ADJUSTMENTS TO THE CATEGORICAL AND PROBABILISTIC LINES HAVE BEEN MADE. THESE ARE BASED LARGELY ON CURRENT TRENDS IN ONGOING DESTABILIZATION...AS REFLECTED IN SATELLITE/RADAR IMAGERY...AND THE LATEST OBJECTIVE INSTABILITY ANALYSES. FOR DETAILS ON GENERAL FORECAST REASONING...PLEASE REFER TO THE LATEST SPC MESOSCALE DISCUSSIONS...AND THE 1630Z OUTLOOK DISCUSSION APPENDED BELOW. ..KERR.. 04/24/2016 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1121 AM CDT SUN APR 24 2016/

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN INCREASE IN TSTM COVERAGE IS ANTICIPATED THROUGH MID-AFTERNOON...WITH ACCOMPANYING PRIMARY THREATS OF DMGG WIND GUSTS AND LARGE HAIL POSSIBLE. A WW WILL LIKELY BE ISSUED BY 20Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STRONG FORCING FOR ASCENT ACCOMPANYING A WELL-DEFINED MID-UPPER LEVEL CYCLONE NEAR THE NEB/WY BORDER IS SPREADING E TOWARDS THE MID-MO VALLEY THIS AFTERNOON. THIS WILL CONTRIBUTE TO INCREASING POTENTIAL FOR TSTM INITIATION WITHIN THE NEXT 1-2 HRS ALONG A SFC DRYLINE ATTENDANT TO THE SYNOPTIC SFC LOW OVER CNTRL SD. ISOLATED ELEVATED TSTMS ARE ALREADY OCCURRING NEAR/N OF I-80 IN E-CNTRL NEB...AND THIS AREA OF CONVECTION SHOULD PERSIST AND GRADUALLY INTENSIFY WHILE MOVING NEWD. A LARGE HAIL THREAT MAY ACCOMPANY INITIAL DISCRETE STORM STRUCTURES THAT DEVELOP...BUT THE MERIDIONAL ORIENTATION OF THE MID-UPPER LEVEL FORCING AND SFC DRYLINE SUGGEST STORM MERGERS/INTERACTIONS WILL LEAD TO AN EVENTUAL EVOLUTION TO A FEW CLUSTERS AND/OR QUASI-LINEAR MODE BY THIS EVENING...SUGGESTING AN INCREASING DMGG WIND THREAT. THE TORNADO THREAT WILL BE LIMITED BY MARGINAL BOUNDARY-LAYER MOISTURE /MID-UPPER 50S F SFC DEWPOINTS/ AND NEARLY UNIDIRECTIONAL DEEP-LAYER WIND PROFILES...BUT MAY STILL BE NON-ZERO WITH ANY LONGER-LIVED SUPERCELL STRUCTURES.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: WIDELY SCATTERED CONVECTIVE INITIATION IS LIKELY DURING THE 20-22Z PERIOD OVER KS AND ISOLATED CONVECTIVE INITIATION IS PROBABLE DURING THE 22-01Z PERIOD FROM THE KS-OK BORDER REGION SWD INTO OK. LARGE TO VERY LARGE HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH STRONGER UPDRAFTS THAT DEVELOP INTO SUPERCELLS. A MODEST WEAK-TORNADO RISK WILL BE CONFINED TO THE EARLY EVENING /23-02Z/ WHEN LOW-LEVEL SHEAR STRENGTHENS AND TEMP/DEWPOINT SPREADS LOWER.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 18Z SURFACE ANALYSIS PLACES A SHARPENING DRYLINE/CONFLUENT LOW-LEVEL FLOW FROM 25 MI W RSL SWD ALONG THE TX-OK BORDER. DEWPOINTS HAVE RISEN INTO THE 59-62 DEG F RANGE DURING THE PAST FEW HOURS IN W-CNTRL OK PER OK MESONET OBSERVATIONS. STRONG HEATING COUPLED WITH GRADUAL MOISTENING ARE CONTRIBUTING TO MODERATE BUOYANCY. WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOWS A WELL-DEFINED MID-LEVEL VORTICITY MAXIMUM ROTATING THROUGH THE BASE OF LARGER-SCALE TROUGH ACROSS W-CNTRL KS EARLY THIS AFTERNOON. THIS FEATURE WILL MOVE INTO CNTRL AND ERN PORTIONS OF KS/S-CNTRL NEB BY LATE AFTERNOON. THE TRAILING PORTION OF THIS FEATURE AND IMPLIED WEAK ASCENT WILL SPREAD ACROSS NWRN OK DURING THE LATE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING. SURFACE OBSERVATIONS DURING THE PAST FEW HOURS IMPLY THE SPC RAP-BASED OBJECTIVE ANALYSES ARE SUFFERING FROM THE RAP OVER-MIXING DRY BIAS YIELDING AN UNDER-REPRESENTATION OF LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE. WRF-BASED GUIDANCE /PARTICULARLY THE NAM/ APPEARS TO EXHIBIT A MORE REASONABLE SOLUTION REGARDING MOISTURE/MIXING AND SUBSEQUENT CAP EROSION AND CONVECTIVE INITIATION PROCESSES. CONVECTIVE INITIATION WILL LIKELY OCCUR FIRST ACROSS CNTRL KS ALONG THE DRYLINE AND GRADUALLY INCLUDE AREAS FARTHER S ALONG THE KS/OK BORDER BY LATE THIS AFTERNOON AND INTO NWRN OK DURING THE EARLY EVENING HOURS. DEEP SHEAR VECTORS ORIENTED ORTHOGONAL TO THE SURFACE BOUNDARIES COUPLED WITH EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDES OF 40-50 KT WILL FAVOR DISCRETE SUPERCELL MODE WITH THE STRONGER/SUSTAINED UPDRAFTS. LOW-LEVEL SHEAR /I.E. SRH/ RISES INTO THE 100-250 M2/S2 RANGE DURING THE 23-02Z PERIOD AND WILL GENERALLY COINCIDE WITH SOME WEAK TORNADO POTENTIAL WITH ANY STRONGER/SUSTAINED SUPERCELL. STRENGTHENING CONVECTIVE INHIBITION AFTER 01-02Z WILL TEND TO RESTRICT STORM INTENSITY/COVERAGE THIS EVENING AS MOST OF THE ACTIVITY DIMINISH

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND STRONG/GUSTY WINDS WILL EXIST FOR THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS. WW ISSUANCE IS UNLIKELY DUE TO THE ISOLATED NATURE OF THE THREAT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE AND SATELLITE WATER VAPOR IMAGERY DEPICT A SHORTWAVE TROUGH ALONG THE MIDDLE TX COAST MOVING NEWD WITH TIME. CONVECTION HAS RECENTLY DEVELOPED ALONG/NEAR THE COAST OF S-CNTRL INTO DEEP S TX ON THE SUBSIDENT/W SIDE OF THIS TROUGH IN A WEAK TO MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIRMASS. SELY SFC WINDS ACROSS THE MCD AREA VEER WITH HEIGHT TO NWLY AROUND 8-9 KM AGL PER RECENT KCRP VWP. WHILE WINDS THROUGH THE LOWER TO MID-TROPOSPHERIC PROFILE ARE NOT OVERLY STRONG...GENERALLY 40 KT OR LESS...SUFFICIENT EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR VALUES OF GENERALLY 30-40 KT OWING MAINLY TO THE STRONGLY VEERING PROFILE WILL SUPPORT STORM ORGANIZATION...INCLUDING SOME SUPERCELL STRUCTURES. LARGE HAIL AND STRONG/GUSTY WINDS WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH ANY THUNDERSTORMS THAT DEVELOP...BUT OVERALL CONVECTIVE COVERAGE IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN ISOLATED AS THE SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVES NEWD THROUGH THE EARLY EVENING. FINALLY...A BRIEF/ISOLATED TORNADO MIGHT BE POSSIBLE WITH 0-1 KM SRH AROUND 130-180 M2/S2 PER KCRP/KBRO VWPS...ALTHOUGH THE STRENGTH OF THE LOW-LEVEL WINDS IS RELATIVELY MODEST.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LARGE HAIL...DAMAGING WINDS...AND ISOLATED TORNADOES WILL CONTINUE TO BE POSSIBLE ACROSS MAINLY NORTHERN PORTIONS OF WW 102. PORTIONS OF THE TORNADO WATCH IN S-CNTRL KS AND N-CNTRL OK MAY BE CANCELLED EARLY IF CURRENT TRENDS CONTINUE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ONGOING SUPERCELL OVER OTTAWA/SALINE COUNTIES IN KS WILL CONTINUE NEWD OVER THE NEXT HOUR...POSING A THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL...DAMAGING WINDS...AND ISOLATED TORNADOES. LATEST RAP MESOANALYSIS AND VWPS FROM KTOP/KICT SUGGEST THE LOW-LEVEL ENVIRONMENT REMAINS FAVORABLE FOR TORNADIC DEVELOPMENT IN THE SHORT TERM ACROSS PARTS OF CNTRL/ERN KS AS A LOW-LEVEL JET PRESENT OVER MUCH OF THE MCD AREA STRENGTHENS WITH TIME THROUGH THE EARLY EVENING. FURTHER S ACROSS S-CNTRL KS INTO N-CNTRL OK...VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS A LACK OF RECENT CUMULUS DEVELOPMENT ALONG THE DRYLINE...AND AGITATED CUMULUS THAT WAS PRESENT EARLIER HAS DISSIPATED. THE POTENTIAL FOR ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT ACROSS THIS REGION IS BECOMING LESS LIKELY THIS EVENING AS LARGE-SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT WITH THE MID-LEVEL SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER THE NRN/CNTRL PLAINS BECOMES INCREASINGLY REMOVED FROM THIS AREA. IF CURRENT TRENDS CONTINUE...PORTIONS OF THE TORNADO WATCH ACROSS S-CNTRL KS INTO N-CNTRL OK MAY BE ABLE TO BE CANCELLED EARLY. ..GLEASON.. 04/24/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THREAT CONTINUES ACROSS WW THIS EVENING. LOCALIZED TORNADO THREAT WILL EXIST ALONG A CORRIDOR FROM THE NEBRASKA/KS BORDER INTO SWRN IA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CLUSTERS OF STRONG/SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS PERSIST ACROSS WW THIS EVENING. RECENTLY...SEVERAL SUPERCELLS HAVE EVOLVED ALONG DRYLINE FROM CLAY/NUCKOLLS COUNTY NEBRASKA...SWD INTO MITCHELL COUNTY KS. ANOTHER SEVERE SUPERCELL OVER SALINE COUNTY KS...POTENTIALLY TORNADIC...SHOULD REMAIN JUST SOUTH OF WW. LATEST DIAGNOSTIC DATA SUGGESTS MOST BUOYANT/SHEARED AIR MASS RESIDES OVER NRN KS INTO SERN NEBRASKA. THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD SPREAD ALONG THIS CORRIDOR TOWARD SWRN IA...COINCIDENT WITH EXPECTED LLJ INCREASE INTO THE MID MS VALLEY REGION THIS EVENING. LARGE HAIL AND PERHAPS A FEW TORNADOES CAN BE EXPECTED WITH THESE SUPERCELLS. FARTHER NORTH...SEVERAL CLUSTERS OF STRONG/SEVERE TSTMS ARE EXPANDING IN AREAL COVERAGE FROM SERN SD INTO NWRN IA. INCREASED WARM ADVECTION ACROSS THIS REGION FAVORS AN EXPANSION/PROGRESSION NORTHEAST INTO SCNTRL MN/NCNTRL IA OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. LARGE HAIL IS THE PRIMARY THREAT WITH THIS ACTIVITY. ..DARROW.. 04/24/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: PRIMARY SEVERE THREAT IS ORIENTING ITSELF ALONG A CORRIDOR FROM NORTHEAST KS INTO NORTHWEST MO. LARGE HAIL WILL BECOME THE MAIN RISK...ALTHOUGH DAMAGING WINDS ARE ALSO POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EARLIER SUPERCELL ACTIVITY THAT EVOLVED ALONG THE DRYLINE ACROSS SRN NEBRASKA AND NRN KS HAS CONGEALED INTO A SW-NE ORIENTED BAND OF SEVERE CONVECTION OVER NERN KS. AS LLJ INCREASES FROM NERN KS INTO SRN IA THIS DEVELOPING SQUALL LINE SHOULD PROPAGATE EWD TOWARD THE MO RIVER. LATEST HAIL ALGORITHM SUGGESTS HAIL GREATER THAN ONE INCH IS COMMON FROM SALINE INTO POTTAWATOMIE COUNTY KS. AS CONVECTION SPREADS EAST OF THE MO RIVER WEAKER INSTABILITY SHOULD LIMIT SEVERE THREAT. ..DARROW.. 04/25/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...
